parsed.name: UHFQA 超高频量子分析仪
parsed.description: 这是一台 Zurich Instruments 的 UHFQA 超高频量子分析仪，用于量子比特读出与高速 IQ 数据采集。该驱动覆盖外部参考时钟同步、默认读出配置加载、AWG 触发采集、结果轮询读取，以及串扰矩阵、相关性、旋转和阈值等读出参数管理。
parsed.description_en: This is a Zurich Instruments UHFQA ultra-high-frequency quantum analyzer used for qubit readout and high-speed IQ data acquisition. The driver supports external reference clock synchronization, loading default readout settings, AWG-triggered acquisition, polling and retrieving results, and managing readout parameters such as crosstalk matrices, correlations, rotations, and thresholds.

actions.description: 执行一次完整采集流程，按设定的样本数、平均次数、通道和模式获取测量数据。
actions.description_en: Run a complete acquisition sequence and collect measurement data with the configured sample count, averages, channels, and mode.

actions.description: 布防采集流程，使仪器进入等待触发和读出准备状态。
actions.description_en: Arm the acquisition process so the instrument is ready for triggering and readout.

actions.description: 结束采集并清理采集相关状态。
actions.description_en: Finalize the acquisition and clean up acquisition-related state.

actions.description: 启动一次测量，等待完成后读取采集数据。
actions.description_en: Start a measurement, wait for completion, and then read out the acquired data.

actions.description: 初始化采集参数，检查 AWG 程序结构并配置读出与循环计数。
actions.description_en: Initialize acquisition parameters, validate the AWG program structure, and configure readout and loop count.

actions.description: 轮询仪器采集结果，直到获得期望数量的样本数据。
actions.description_en: Poll the instrument for acquisition results until the expected number of samples is available.

actions.description: 确保仪器使用并锁定外部参考时钟。
actions.description_en: Ensure that the instrument is using and locked to an external reference clock.

actions.description: 清除仪器当前错误状态。
actions.description_en: Clear the current instrument error state.

actions.description: 读取仪器时钟频率。
actions.description_en: Read the instrument clock frequency.

actions.description: 读取仪器中的串扰抑制矩阵。
actions.description_en: Download the crosstalk suppression matrix from the instrument.

actions.description: 加载默认读出配置，包括时钟、输出、触发和结果记录等设置。
actions.description_en: Load default readout settings, including clock, outputs, triggers, and result logging configuration.

actions.description: 打印相关性参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of correlation parameters.

actions.description: 打印串扰矩阵与串扰相关参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of the crosstalk matrix and related crosstalk settings.

actions.description: 打印通道去偏斜或时序校正参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of channel deskew or timing correction parameters.

actions.description: 打印积分读出参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of integration readout parameters.

actions.description: 打印仪器关键参数总览。
actions.description_en: Print a general overview of key instrument parameters.

actions.description: 打印读出旋转参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of readout rotation parameters.

actions.description: 打印判决阈值参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of discrimination threshold parameters.

actions.description: 打印用户寄存器参数概览。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of user register parameters.

actions.description: 重置采集相关参数到默认状态。
actions.description_en: Reset acquisition-related parameters to their default state.

actions.description: 重置相关性参数到默认状态。
actions.description_en: Reset correlation parameters to their default state.

actions.description: 重置串扰抑制矩阵到默认值。
actions.description_en: Reset the crosstalk suppression matrix to its default values.

actions.description: 重置读出旋转参数到默认状态。
actions.description_en: Reset readout rotation parameters to their default state.

actions.description: 上传串扰抑制矩阵到仪器。
actions.description_en: Upload a crosstalk suppression matrix to the instrument.
